name: Should I build a detached guest house or convert an existing garage?

mainEntity.name: Should I build a detached guest house or convert an existing garage?

acceptedAnswer.text: Deciding between building a detached guest house or converting an existing garage involves considering your property layout, budget, and desired functionality. A detached unit offers more privacy and design flexibility but typically incurs higher construction costs and may require more extensive utility extensions. Garage conversions can be more cost-effective and quicker to complete, but they are limited by the existing structure's footprint and may require less significant structural changes. A practical tradeoff to consider is the impact on parking; converting a garage means losing that parking space.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose between a detached guest house for privacy and flexibility, or a garage conversion for potential cost savings and faster completion. Consider budget, desired function, and parking impact when making this decision.
